verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms does document automations, such as managed payout schedules and configurable risk monitoring rules, so the versioning and rollback axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review or approval workflows, change history, or rollback for those automations or configurations. Webhooks, the MCP server and test credentials are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
